claim_text: An outside party accessed 403 tentative job offers in USA Staffing on Nov 12-13
summary: MSW Media says an internal OPM email told USA Staffing users that an outside third party accessed 403 tentative job offers on Nov 12 and 13.
detail: This rests on one outlet's description of an internal email that readers cannot see in full. The outlet is a single-author newsletter, which this site lists as Tier 3, not an established newsroom. We found no OPM statement and no second outlet with its own sourcing. How the party got in is not stated.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: MSW Media says it reviewed the email and quotes its content; the part shown has signature blocks removed.

claim_text: The data included names, emails, agency, position, grade, duty location and starting salary
summary: Per the email as described, the offers included selectee names, emails, hiring agencies, positions, grades, duty locations and starting salaries.
detail: No Social Security numbers or other identifiers are mentioned in the report. We have no way to check the list against the email.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: MSW Media lists these fields as the email's description of what the offers contained.

claim_text: OPM's cybersecurity team confirmed the access on Nov 14, blocked it, and notified those affected
summary: Per the email, OPM's cyber team confirmed the breach on Nov 14, investigated and blocked the access, and notified those affected.
detail: This is the email's account, relayed by MSW Media, not an OPM statement.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: MSW Media relays these steps from the email.

claim_text: USA Staffing added a sign-in requirement to prevent this kind of access
summary: Per the email, USA Staffing added a sign-in requirement to stop this type of access.
detail: The report does not say what the access method was, so we cannot say what the sign-in change addresses.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: MSW Media relays this fix from the email.

claim_text: USA Staffing is OPM's hiring system for federal agencies
summary: USA Staffing is the OPM system federal agencies use to recruit, assess, select and onboard employees.
detail: This is background about the system, not about the reported access.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: OPM's own privacy assessment describes the system and its purpose.

claim_text: OPM has published no statement about this
summary: OPM's news releases page showed nothing on the topic as of Nov 21, and its cybersecurity page has no incident notice.
detail: The releases page's latest item is dated Nov 2. A missing statement does not show the report is wrong.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Both OPM pages were read on Nov 20 and again on Nov 21 and carry no notice about USA Staffing.

claim_text: The access was a cyberattack or hack
summary: The email, as described, calls it a breach by an outside third party, but the method and the actor are not described.
detail: 'Outside party' and 'breach' are the email's and the outlet's words. No method, actor or intent is reported.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: MSW Media describes an outside third party accessing the offers but gives no method or actor.

claim_text: The access is linked to the FAA ground stop or the Microsoft outage
summary: No source links them. The report only notes the dates overlap and says there is no indication of a link.
detail: MSW Media's headline puts the OPM access next to the FAA ground stop, but its text says there is no indication the breach is tied to any other outage or incident.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The article itself says there is no indication the access is tied to other incidents that weekend.
